claude_proposed_widenings.name: stored_spell_reservoir_magic_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Reserve needs a persistent spell-storage payload with capacity by spell level, ingestion of third-party casts into the item, and later release using the original caster's DC/attack/ability. No existing magic-item family can represent storing and later casting arbitrary spells from item state.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This vibrant purple prism stores spells cast into it, holding them until you use them. The stone can store up to 4 levels of spells at a time.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_periodic_trigger_for_magic_items
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Regeneration is a passive item benefit with a repeating time trigger and HP-threshold predicate. PassiveMechanics only grants always-on atoms, and magic items have no non-spell ongoing-effect family.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You regain 15 Hit Points at the end of each hour if you have at least 1 Hit Point while this white spindle orbits your head.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_proficiency_bonus
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Mastery changes the wearer's Proficiency Bonus directly. No existing effect atom modifies PB.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Your Proficiency Bonus increases by 1 while this pale green prism orbits your head.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: reaction_trigger_visible_creature_casts_spell_with_max_level
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Absorption and Greater Absorption are reaction items keyed to a visible caster and bounded by triggering spell level. Current ReactionTrigger can express only generic creature_casts_spell by components, not visibility or level caps.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Reaction to cancel a spell of level 4 or lower cast by a creature you can see

claude_proposed_widenings.name: suppress_food_and_drink_need
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Sustenance removes biological upkeep requirements. The current effect vocabulary has no nourishment/survival-maintenance atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You don't need to eat or drink while this clear spindle orbits your head.
